top5.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83
top5.description: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the initial range of $70 to $78. The company is preparing to begin public trading.
top5.why: Anthropic priced its IPO above the expected range, creating a major public-market test for a leading AI company and setting a benchmark for AI valuations.

top5.title: Nvidia employees call for Jensen Huang’s return, but the board refuses
top5.description: A week after Jensen Huang’s resignation, Nvidia employees called for his return, while the board says it does not want to reinstate him. Management is offering raises and stock grants to retain talent.
top5.why: The leadership crisis at Nvidia, combined with efforts to retain employees through higher pay and stock grants, could affect the world’s most important AI-chip company and its market value.

top5.title: OpenAI says its models improved AMD chip designs by 14%
top5.description: OpenAI says its models improved the power, performance and area of AMD chip designs by up to 14%. AMD incorporated some of the changes into a design sent for manufacturing.
top5.why: OpenAI’s reported 14% improvement to AMD chip designs suggests AI-assisted hardware engineering is becoming commercially meaningful and could intensify competition in the accelerator market.

top5.title: An Optimizely vulnerability spreads malware across major websites
top5.description: Attackers exploited Optimizely’s experimentation software to distribute malicious JavaScript on the websites of at least 178 organizations. The payloads targeted cryptocurrency wallets and payment data, among other things.
top5.why: Attackers used a vulnerability in Optimizely to distribute malware across at least 178 organizations, highlighting the systemic exposure created by widely deployed software platforms.

top5.title: Trump administration considers requiring disclosure of Chinese AI use
top5.description: The Trump administration is considering requiring U.S. companies to disclose their use of Chinese artificial intelligence systems.
top5.why: A possible U.S. requirement to disclose the use of Chinese AI systems would add compliance obligations and deepen the technology separation between the United States and China.
